name: Bill 01
query:
SELECT 
    b.resident AS "Resident:Data:150",
    b.billing_month AS "Billing Month:Data:120",
    b.billing_year AS "Billing Year:Int:100",
    b.due_date AS "Due Date:Date:120",
    b.custom_email AS "Member Email:Data:200",
    b.status AS "Status:Data:100",
    b.days_late AS "Days Late:Int:100",
    b.late_fee_per_day AS "Late Fee per Day:Currency:150",
    b.late_fee_amount AS "Late Fee Amount:Currency:150",
    COALESCE(SUM(i.amount), 0) AS "Consumption Amount:Currency:160",
    (COALESCE(SUM(i.amount), 0) + COALESCE(b.late_fee_amount, 0)) AS "Total Amount with Late:Currency:160"
FROM `tabBill` b
LEFT JOIN `tabBill Item` i ON i.parent = b.name
GROUP BY b.name
ORDER BY b.billing_year DESC, b.billing_month DESC, b.resident ASC;
